_comment: Derived journal Leads: un-started mainline hooks whose prerequisites are met. Pure counter reads; a lead vanishes when its hide_when (the quest-start counter) banks. Every row MIRRORS its target dialogue option's own requires/hide_when exactly -- a lead that fires one waking early points at a refusal. v0.15 spec A2.

leads.lead_text: The Guild posted a Watch notice about the reopened gallery.
Ceria's been planning a dig east past the floodplains.
Pisces keeps looking at the Door like it owes him a letter.
Eloise has been eyeing the way you arrived.
Hedault keeps stopping mid-appraisal when your Door comes up.
Grimalkin has been about to say something since your papers were stamped.
